# Group channel overview

A Group channel is a common multi-user communication format in instant messaging apps, typically involving two or more users. Nexconn's Group channel feature supports rich member management, mute management, offline message push, and message history roaming — suitable for interest groups, work groups, customer service, and more.

Key points about Group channels:

* Nexconn provides complete group management capabilities, supporting group creation, dissolution, member management, and profile maintenance through both server-side APIs and client-side SDKs. Group and member profile information (avatars, names, member cards, etc.) is managed and maintained by Nexconn.
* There is no limit on the number of groups that can be created under an App Key. Each group supports up to 300 members by default. For applications with more than 10,000 monthly active users, this limit can be raised to 1,000 on Starter or 3,000 on Pro.
* There is no limit on the number of groups a single user can join.

## Group management features[​](#group-management-features "Direct link to Group management features")

Nexconn provides complete group management capabilities, supporting group operations through both server-side APIs and client-side SDKs. When group management operations are performed, group members receive status notification callbacks — for example: create, join, invite, kick, leave, dissolve, add admin, remove admin, transfer Channel owner, and so on.

tip

Because notifications are implemented as messages, they count toward group message distribution and downlink data statistics.

| Feature                                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                               | Client API                                                                                                       | Nexconn Server API                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Create a group                             | Create a group; the creator becomes the Channel owner by default.                                                                                                                         | [Create Group (Client)](/chatsdk-web/group-channel/group-manage.md#create-group)                                 | [Create Group (Server)](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/managing-channels/create-group.md)                                    |
| Set group profile                          | Modify the group's name, avatar, description, and other built-in or custom profile fields.                                                                                                | [Set Group Profile (Client)](/chatsdk-web/group-channel/group-manage.md)                                         | [Set Group Profile (Server)](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/managing-channels/update-group-info.md)                          |
| Get group profiles in bulk                 | Retrieve profile information for multiple specified groups.                                                                                                                               | [Get Group Profiles in Bulk (Client)](/chatsdk-web/group-channel/group-info.md)                                  | [Get Group Profiles in Bulk (Server)](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/managing-channels/list-group-channel-profiles.md)       |
| Kick a member                              | Remove a specified user from the group. Only users with kick permission can perform this operation.                                                                                       | [Kick Member (Client)](/chatsdk-web/group-channel/group-manage.md#kick-member)                                   | [Remove Member (Server)](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/managing-members/quit-group.md)                                      |

| Join a group                               | Join a specified group. A single user can join up to 1,000 groups on Free, 2,000 on Starter, and 5,000 on Pro.                                                                            | [Join Group (Client)](/chatsdk-web/group-channel/join-group.md#join-group)                                       | [Join Group (Server)](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/managing-members/join-group.md)                                         |
| Leave a group                              | Leave a specified group. The user no longer receives new messages from the group after leaving.                                                                                           | [Leave Group (Client)](/chatsdk-web/group-channel/group-manage.md#leave-group)                                   | [Leave Group (Server)](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/managing-members/quit-group.md)                                        |

### Basic group operations via server API[​](#basic-group-operations-via-server-api "Direct link to Basic group operations via server API")

In addition to the complete group management features above, Nexconn also provides a set of basic Server API endpoints for fundamental group operations such as creation, dissolution, and member management:

| Feature                                 | Description                                                                                                                                                     | Nexconn Server API                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Create / Dissolve group                 | Provide the creator's user ID, group ID, and group name to request group creation from the Nexconn server. Dissolving a group removes all member relationships. | [Create Group](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/managing-channels/create-group.md), [Dissolve Group](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/managing-members/dismiss-group.md) |
| Join / Leave group                      | After joining, only messages created after joining are visible by default. After leaving, the user no longer receives new messages from the group.              | [Join Group](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/managing-members/join-group.md), [Leave Group](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/managing-members/quit-group.md)            |
| Update Nexconn server group information | Update the group information used in Nexconn's push service.                                                                                                    | [Refresh Group Info](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/managing-channels/update-group-info.md)                                                                            |
| Query group members                     | Query the user IDs of all members in a specified group.                                                                                                         | [Query Group Members](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/managing-member-profiles/query-group-members.md)                                                                  |
| Query groups a user belongs to          | Query all groups a user has joined by user ID, returning group IDs and names.                                                                                   | [Query Groups User Belongs To](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/managing-channels/query-user-groups.md)                                                                  |
| Mute a single member                    | Mute one or more users in a specified group or across all groups. Muted users can still view messages from others but cannot send messages via the client SDK.  | [Mute Single Member](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/mute/gag-user.md)                                                                                                  |
| Freeze a group                          | Prevent all members of a group from sending messages. To allow specific users to send messages, add them to the allowed senders list.                           | [Freeze Group](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/mute/ban-group.md)                                                                                                       |
| Allowed senders list                    | After a group is frozen, users on the allowed senders list can still send group messages.                                                                       | [Allowed Senders List](/platform-chat-api/group-channel/mute/add-to-group-ban-whitelist.md)                                                                              |

## Group channel messaging[​](#group-channel-messaging "Direct link to Group channel messaging")

Group channel messaging works similarly to Direct Channel messaging and shares some APIs and configuration.

| Feature                               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                          | Client API                                                             | Nexconn Server API                                                                     |
| ------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Send a message                        | Send regular or media messages — such as text, images, and GIFs — or custom messages. You can include @ mentions when sending.                                                                       | [Send Message](/chatsdk-web/message/send.md)                           | [Send Group Message](/platform-chat-api/message/send-group.md)                         |
| Send a group @ message                | Specify @ target users when sending a group message. Mentioned users receive a special notification.                                                                                                 | [Send Group @ Message](/chatsdk-web/group-channel/groupat.md)          | Not available                                                                          |
| Send a directional group message      | Send a regular or media message to one or more specific group members; other members do not receive it.                                                                                              | [Send Directional Group Message](/chatsdk-web/group-channel/direct.md) | [Send Directional Group Message (Server)](/platform-chat-api/message/send-group.md)    |
| Receive messages                      | Listen for and receive messages in real time, or receive offline messages when the client comes online.                                                                                              | [Receive Messages](/chatsdk-web/message/receive.md)                    | N/A                                                                                    |
| Group message read receipts           | After sending a group message, send a read receipt request to retrieve read status data from recipients.                                                                                             | [Group Message Read Receipts](/chatsdk-web/message/read-receipt.md)    | N/A                                                                                    |
| Offline messages                      | Supports offline message storage; retention period is configurable (1–7 days), defaulting to all group messages within 7 days. Retention duration and message count can be adjusted.                 | Not available                                                          | Not available                                                                          |
| Control offline push properties       | When the recipient is offline, group messages can trigger push notifications. Configure push properties (`IPushConfig`) to control the display and behavior of push notifications on mobile devices. | [Send Message](/chatsdk-web/message/send.md)                           | Not available                                                                          |
| Delete a message                      | A sent message can be deleted.                                                                                                                                                                       | [Delete a Message](/chatsdk-web/message/delete.md#delete-for-everyone) | [Delete a Message](/platform-chat-api/message/msgrecall.md)                            |
| Get message history                   | Retrieve message history from the local database or remote. Cloud retention is enabled by default for direct, group, and system channels, with a default retention period of 180 days (6 months).    | [Get Message History](/chatsdk-web/message/get-history.md)             | Not available                                                                          |
| Get message history logs              | Nexconn's server can store the history of all channels in the app. History is provided as compressed log files. Use the Server API to retrieve or delete history logs for a specified app.           | Not available                                                          | Documentation pending                                                                  |
| Delete remote messages                | Delete specific messages, messages before a specified timestamp, or all history messages in a channel from the server.                                                                               | [Delete Messages](/chatsdk-web/message/delete.md)                      | [Clear Messages](/platform-chat-api/message/delete.md)                                 |
| Direct/Group Channel message metadata | Add status tags (key-value pairs) to existing messages; provides APIs to add, delete, and query metadata.                                                                                            | [Message Metadata](/chatsdk-web/message/expansion)                     | [Direct/Group Channel Message Metadata](/platform-chat-api/message/expansion-about.md) |
| Custom message types                  | If the built-in message types don't meet your needs, define custom message types. Both custom regular and media message types are supported.                                                         | [Custom Messages](/chatsdk-web/message/customize.md)                   | N/A                                                                                    |

## Group History Configuration[​](#group-history-configuration "Direct link to Group History Configuration")

* Console UI
* AI with MCP

By default, newly joined members can only see messages created after they joined. To allow members to view history before they joined, enable **Enable pre-join history access by new member** under **Chat** > **Chat settings** > **Group Channels** on the [Chat settings](https://console.nexconn.ai/agile/im/service/config) page in the console.

If you've configured the [nexconn-console MCP server](/chatsdk-web/build-with-ai/configure-mcp-server.md), ask your AI coding assistant:

> Allow new group members to view pre-join history in my Nexconn app

The AI will use the appropriate MCP tool to configure this setting automatically.

Group channel channel features work similarly to Direct Channel and share some APIs and configuration.

| Feature                              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                          | Client API                                                                                     | Nexconn Server API                                              |
| ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Get remote channels                  | Retrieve the channel list from the server (up to 1,000). Supports fetching specific channels, pinned channels, and channels with unread messages.                                                    | [Get Channels](/chatsdk-web/channel/get-list.md)                                               | Not available                                                   |
| Manage unread message count          | Get or clear the unread message count in a channel for UI display.                                                                                                                                   | [Channel Unread Count](/chatsdk-web/channel/unread.md)                                         | Not available                                                   |
| Delete a channel                     | Remove a specific channel from the channel list.                                                                                                                                                     | [Delete Channel](/chatsdk-web/channel/delete.md)                                               | Not available                                                   |
| Channel draft                        | Save a draft to a specified channel.                                                                                                                                                                 | [Channel Draft](/chatsdk-web/channel/draft.md)                                                 | Not available                                                   |
| Manage channel tags                  | Create and manage tag data to group and categorize channels. Each user can create up to 20 tags. Tag data is synced to the Nexconn server.                                                           | [Manage Channel Tag Data](/chatsdk-web/channel/manage-conversation-tags.md)                    | Not available                                                   |
| Set and use channel tags             | Organize channels into groups using channel tags.                                                                                                                                                    | [Set and Use Channel Tags](/chatsdk-web/channel/conversationTag.md)                            | Not available                                                   |
| Pin a channel                        | Pin a specified channel to the top of the channel list.                                                                                                                                              | [Pin a Channel](/chatsdk-web/channel/stick-to-top.md)                                          | [Pin a Channel](/platform-chat-api/channel/top.md)              |
| Do Not Disturb (DND)                 | Control whether offline push notifications are sent when the user's device is offline. Supports DND by channel or by channel type.                                                                   | [DND Overview](/chatsdk-web/channel/do-not-disturb-about.md)                                   | [DND Overview](/platform-chat-api/push/do-not-disturb-about.md) |
| Multi-device sync for DND/pin status | The SDK provides a channel status sync mechanism. After setting a channel status sync listener, changes to DND or pin status made on other devices are reflected in real time on the current device. | [Multi-device Sync DND/Pin](/chatsdk-web/channel/share-conversation-status-between-clients.md) | N/A                                                             |
| Multi-device sync for read status    | Actively sync the read status of a channel across multiple devices under the same user account.                                                                                                      | [Multi-device Sync Read Status](/chatsdk-web/channel/syncReadStatus.md)                        | N/A                                                             |
